edges.reason: Fallback function forwards execution to play_game(0)
play_paper calls play_game(0)
play_scissors calls play_game(1)
play_stone calls play_game(2)
play_game calls compare to decide the outcome
resolve calls judge to decode the record
resolve calls mora to stringify hands
resolve calls win to stringify the result
view_last_result calls resolve on record[_address]
self_last_result forwards to view_last_result(msg.sender)
self_readyTime forwards to view_readyTime(msg.sender)
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership
onlyOwner modifier gates set_amount
onlyOwner modifier gates set_address
onlyOwner modifier gates set_cooldown
onlyOwner modifier gates withdraw
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner
msg.sender keys readyTime and record and is the payout recipient in play_game
play_game uses block.timestamp for the cooldown check and for setting readyTime
Pseudo-random computer choice is derived from block.timestamp (and block.difficulty)
view_readyTime compares block.timestamp against readyTime[_address]
self_last_result passes msg.sender into view_last_result
self_readyTime passes msg.sender into view_readyTime
transferOwnership reads (onlyOwner check) and writes the owner state variable
newOwner parameter is the new value written by transferOwnership
newOwner value is stored into owner
new_amount parameter flows into set_amount
User-supplied new_amount is multiplied by 10**18 without overflow checks
new_address parameter is written into tokenAddress
new_cooldown parameter is written into cooldown
_amount parameter is used in the external token transfer inside withdraw
tokenAddress selects the external contract called by withdraw
owner is the recipient of the external token transfer in withdraw
withdraw performs the external ERC20Basic.transfer call
tokenAddress selects the external contract called on payout in play_game
amount state variable is the value transferred to the winning player
msg.sender is the recipient of the external token transfer on a win
play_game executes the external ERC20Basic.transfer call when result == 2
The result value controls whether the external payout call is executed
play parameter selects the player's hand in play_game
play_game computes the computer hand comp
play_game stores the outcome returned by compare into result
Weak pseudorandom value determines the computer hand comp
Predictable randomness determines the game outcome and the reward payout
Player hand is passed to compare as player argument
Computer hand is passed to compare as computer argument
Encoded game result is written into record[msg.sender]
Player hand is packed into record[msg.sender]
Computer hand is packed into record[msg.sender]
compare returns the outcome consumed by play_game
player parameter flows into compare
computer parameter flows into compare
compare accumulates its decision in the _result local
orig packed record flows into judge
judge computes local _result
judge computes local _play
judge computes local _comp
orig hand value flows into mora
mora assigns the returned hand string to _mora
_result flows into win
win assigns the returned outcome string to result
orig record parameter flows into resolve
resolve populates its string return variables
Decoded values from judge are consumed by resolve
mora string conversions are returned by resolve
win string conversion is returned by resolve
view_last_result reads record[_address]
_address parameter selects the record entry to read
view_readyTime reads readyTime[_address]
_address parameter selects the readyTime entry to read
cooldown is added to block.timestamp when the player loses
readyTime[msg.sender] is checked and updated in play_game
amount is scaled by 10**18 without overflow protection
set_amount performs unchecked multiplication new_amount*10**18
Scaled value is written into the amount state variable
play_game packs result*9 + play*3 + comp with unchecked uint8 arithmetic
judge decodes using unchecked division and modulo on uint8 values
Packed arithmetic result is stored into record[msg.sender]
The external token transfer can call back into withdraw before completion
A malicious token contract can re-enter play_game during the payout transfer

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used to update the owner state variable inside transferOwnership
new_amount is only consumed by set_amount when scaling the reward
new_address is only written into tokenAddress by set_address
new_cooldown is only written into cooldown by set_cooldown
_amount is only used as the value of the external transfer inside withdraw
play is the player hand argument of play_game and of the internal compare call
player is the first argument used in the comparison logic of compare
computer is the second argument used in the comparison logic of compare
orig is the packed record decoded by judge
orig is the hand value mapped to a string by mora
_result is the outcome value mapped to a string by win
orig is forwarded to judge by resolve
_address is only used to index record in view_last_result
_address is only used to index readyTime in view_readyTime
comp is the computer hand computed inside play_game
result is the outcome computed inside play_game and used to trigger the payout
_result is the accumulator returned by compare
_result is the decoded outcome produced inside judge
_play is the decoded player hand produced inside judge
_comp is the decoded computer hand produced inside judge
_mora is the string returned by mora
result is the string returned by win
result/play/comp create the string tuple returned by resolve
